text:
Alyssa: quick Q2 milestone check — model-routing rollout status. Canary looked good for correctness but we saw a 1.6x p95 latency bump on burst traffic yesterday. who owns the final rollout and can we get a quick plan? :eyes:

Matt: I investigated. regression seems correlated with a batching tweak from the runtime team. reverted locally, latency returns to baseline. suspect runtime.max_batch_tokens change.

Raj: pinging @matt and @susan — Susan, does the dedicated pool autoscaler touch batching configs?

Susan: autoscaler doesn't modify batch tokens, only pool size. the change was likely from the runtime release two days ago. I can hold the Dedicated rollout if needed.

Emma: shipped status for Q2 milestone: "routing canary" completed validation (functional tests + smoke). blocked: full rollout delayed by perf regression. next step = decide rollback or config pin.

Alyssa: proposed plan: 1) revert runtime change on canary pools (fast rollback), 2) open follow-up to re-evaluate batching heuristics behind a feature flag, 3) update OKR status (slipped -> mitigation in progress). ok? :+1:

Matt: I can push rollback to canary right now. command I used in repro:
```bash
redwoodctl rollout apply --pool routing-canary --set runtime.max_batch_tokens=512
```
Doing it asynchronously, will post deploy-bot link.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by Matt: rollout/1728510050 -> routing-canary (revert runtime.max_batch_tokens). logs: https://deploys.redwood.example/rollout/1728510050 :rocket:

Alyssa: thanks. Raj, can you own the PR to add the feature-flag and test suite for the batching heuristic? we should avoid a blind reintroduce.

Raj: I will. creating PR now and tagging runtime + infra for review. PTAL @matt @emma. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pulls/4123

Matt: looking. quick note: add a perf regression test that simulates bursty seq lengths (50% short, 50% long). saved me time reproing.

Emma: marking OKR milestone "Routing rollout (Q2)" as: shipped=functional, slipped=full rollout, next=rollback-deployed + PR for flag + rerun perf gates. I'll update the tracker.

Susan: Dedicated customers using routing canary? one account with reserved capacity got routed yesterday; I notified support to expect flakiness and gave mitigation guidance.

Alyssa: good. can we get a short timeline estimate? Matt, how long to confirm rollback stabilizes canary perf?

Matt: 20–30m to observe p95 over two 10-min windows. I started the rollback at 1728510050. will report back at 1728510350 (approx).

deploy-bot: Rollout finished: routing-canary reverted. status=success. metrics: p95 back to baseline (~0% change). link: https://deploys.redwood.example/rollout/1728510050/results

Matt: confirmed — p95 returned to baseline. leaving canary paused for 1h for additional monitoring.

Raj: PR opened and assigned, adding perf test and feature flag. ETA for review + merge: EOD today.

Alyssa: perfect. next actions: 1) Emma update OKR sheet, mark partial ship + slip, 2) Raj owns PR, 3) Matt/Infra keep canary paused and smoke for 1h, 4) Susan notify support and flag customer impact. I'll collect a short note for the all-hands tomorrow.

Emma: done — OKR updated and brief added for all-hands.

Susan: support notified, added a short postmortem note in ops channel.

Alyssa: thanks everyone. if anything else shows during the pause call it out here. closing async check-in. :white_check_mark:
